experiment: exp33 context-prediction residual with a whitened target

config.whitening: PCA whitening in the top 64 directions, fitted on the predictor's training units
config.predictor: width 128, 2 pre-norm transformer layers, 4 heads, ff 256, sinusoidal 2-d positions, learned mask token
config.training: MSE on hidden positions, 0.25 random mask per unit per step, Adam 0.001, 400 steps, batch 64 units
config.scoring: 2 rounds of 4 disjoint quarter masks (K = 8), every patch hidden 2 times
config.null: the residual is a boundary detector: wins against WorldCover, loses on hand labels

prereg.combination: U+ = mean of within-scene midrank percentiles of confidence and of the primary score
prereg.note: river-level one-sided exact sign tests are the inference; scene-level W/L/T are descriptive
Bolivia is one flood event; per-tile signs are descriptive, not an exact test
